children with intellectual disabilities show different profiles of cognitive functioning and adaptive behavior.
children with intellectual disabilities can be grouped into three profiles according to their cognitive functioning and their adaptive behaviors.

the identification of children with intellectual disability at risk of psychopathology.
the relationship between cognitive and adaptive behavior deficits and psychopathological manifestations in children with intellectual disabilities.

the three profiles differ according to the cognitive functions and adaptive behaviors.

children with intellectual disabilities show different cognitive profiles, which have consequences on their adaptive behaviors and on social competences.

the cognitive and adaptive behavior profiles of children with intellectual disability are not associated with psychopathological symptoms.
